products.short_description: Federate Entra ID with Google Cloud Identity for SSO and stand up provisioning (GCDS/SCIM) — consistent accounts, groups, and licensing across both clouds — the identity foundation for the transformation, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
One identity across Microsoft and Google

In a Google transformation, identity is the backbone: users must sign in once and exist consistently across both clouds. This solution federates Microsoft Entra ID with Google Cloud Identity for SSO and stands up provisioning (Google Cloud Directory Sync / SCIM) so accounts, groups, and licensing stay consistent — the identity foundation for coexistence and migration, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the identity model: Entra ID as IdP federating to Google (SAML/OIDC), provisioning via GCDS or SCIM, and how source-of-truth flows.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Entra ID + Google super-admin, source of truth, GCDS host or SCIM, DNS, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to configure Entra→Google SSO federation, set up GCDS/SCIM provisioning of users+groups, validate sign-in and provisioning on a named pilot, then expand.
  • 5 supporting scripts — identity-readiness discovery, per-user SSO + provisioning validation, an identity coverage/exception report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (SSO works, users/groups provisioned, licensing correct) plus Best Practices for source-of-truth and lifecycle.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

One identity across Microsoft and Google — single sign-on and consistent provisioning — underpinning coexistence, migration, and secure access through the transformation.

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
